title: Labyrinthine dreams being the "entry" to the mallworld?
content: So I've noticed a pattern, sort of. When I'm asleep and my dreams start going... weird, I always end up somewhere in the mall world. I'll use last night as an example. I was having what I consider to be a normal dream, when the other two characters there started acting weird. Too nervous, too quiet, too focused. Out of character. (I do want to say, I recognized one of them, he's my dad's best friend that I've known since I was born. The other one I didn't recognize.) We were in a hospital, or something. It didn't look like a hospital, but that was the feeling I kept getting. I kept asking them what we needed here, what we were doing, and they kept shushing me or waving my question away. That's kind of when I realized we had been going in circles, sort of. We kept making right turns down different cramped hallways with photos and knick knacks on the wall, and finally Andy (one of the people with me) answered that we were looking for someone but didn't elaborate. We finally got to the right place, I guess, because they both stopped in front of a door and Andy motioned for me to leave with the other guy that was with us. We both went back the way we had just come, with me feeling increasingly lost, my concern and confusion falling on deaf ears. Then we finally got to an exit and the guy that was with me... he shoved me through the wall and I... it's like I faded out almost? Things got really fuzzy and out of focus, like I was tuned into the wrong channel. Then I woke up. It was 4:27 AM exactly. I had had some issues falling asleep already, and I couldn't fall back asleep no matter what I did. So I've been thinking back on all of my other experiences in the mallworld, and almost every time I've been I've felt like I've gotten lost right before I ended up there. There's been a couple of dreams where I've gotten lost but the other characters in the dream usually stop me from actually fully going to the mallworld, or try at least. Then it follows that same pattern of feeling like I'm behind foggy glass, or tuned into the wrong station before I wake up. Maybe it's nothing, but figured I'd share in case anyone else has noticed patterns!
